title: Psalms 60
paragraphs: ¹ O God, you have rejected and broken us; you have been angry — now restore us! ² You shook the land and split it open; repair its cracks, for it is falling apart. ³ You have shown your people desperate times; you have made us drink wine that staggers us. ⁴ But you have raised a banner for those who fear you — a rallying point away from the archers. Selah. ⁵ Deliver those you love; save us and answer us by your right hand.

⁶ God has spoken in his holiness: "With joy I will divide up Shechem and measure out the Valley of Sukkoth. ⁷ Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah is my scepter. ⁸ Moab is my washbasin; on Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph." ⁹ Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom? ¹⁰ Is it not you, O God, who rejected us? Will you not march out with our armies?
¹¹ Give us help against the enemy, for human help is worthless. ¹² With God we will do mighty things; it is he who will crush our enemies.
